operation.description: report writes four complete files for selected fixed cluster(s); query filters a fresh collection; list_clusters returns one page (limit/offset) of the configured multi-subscription roster without authentication/network, not observed health.

view.description: findings exposes all checks; report findings contains failed checks only. coverage exposes scoped source receipts. architecture exposes observed nodes/edges and explicit unknowns.

cluster_name.description: Exact key of the fixed operator allowlist (APPROVED_CLUSTERS, up to 500 clusters across subscriptions). Empty selects the first configured cluster. The code rejects any name outside the allowlist; do not add an enum for large fleets.

cluster_names.description: One to five distinct, exact comma-separated fixed allowlist names, without spaces. Mutually exclusive with cluster_name. Every selected snapshot is preserved; a failed cluster never substitutes empty/healthy data.

namespace.description: Exact local namespace filter, never a server-side scope override.

workload_name.description: Exact local workload-name filter; no URL/path/query/command.

limit.description: Requested row count; 3500-byte default-JSON budget may return fewer whole rows with exact paging disclosure.

offset.description: Local offset in this fresh collection; not a persistent cursor.
